tests.name: hidden and repeated fade-out close calls have no extra close event or revision
immediate escalation finishes the existing close once and cannot tear down a newly opened page
generated open/close/immediate/tick sequences preserve model state and one close event per transition
a real close advances the return token once and cancels owned feedback once
optional background, tooltip and zoom handlers may be absent during close
generated focus boundaries keep inert, hidden and disabled controls out of sequential navigation
